item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel for the day you're building, so decide your meals before hunger decides for you. Eat something with protein early, and keep water close. Notice whether you're eating from real hunger or from stress, and pause for a breath before the second helping. Plan a simple, steady dinner, and leave room for a calm evening. Your action: right now, choose your next meal and what's in it.
